phrases.zh: 到达那里；取得成功，实现目标
分发，发出；公布，发表；用尽，精疲力竭
增减……而无大变化；允许有小误差

examples.en: Air bags are a standard feature in most new cars.
examples.zh: 气囊是大多数新车的标准配置。

examples.en: Striped tails are a common feature of many animals.
examples.zh: 尾巴上有条纹是许多动物的共同特征。

examples.en: The hotel’s only redeeming features (= things that make it acceptable ) were that it was cheap and near the city centre.
examples.zh: 这家旅馆仅有的可取之处就是价格低廉并且靠近市中心。

phrases.zh: 主要特征；主要特点；主景；功能特点
专用功能部件；特别策划；特别收录

examples.en: Are those men following us?
examples.zh: 那些人在跟着我们吗？

examples.en: The patrol car followed the BMW for a few miles and then lost it.
examples.zh: 巡逻车跟了那辆宝马几英里，后来就跟丢了。

examples.en: Tom’s already gone out to Rome and his wife and children will follow shortly.
examples.zh: 汤姆已经去罗马了，他的妻儿很快就会跟着去。

phrases.zh: 跟踪；坚持完成；继续做某事
坚持到底；完成球棒击球后的弧形动作
按照说明；听从指示；按照技术指导

examples.en: He started to explain, but he didn’t get far (= he did not succeed in saying very much ) before Mary interrupted him.
examples.zh: 他开始解释起来，但没说几句就被玛丽打断了。

examples.en: Many people felt that the new law did not go far enough (= did not have a big enough effect, so that more needed to be done ) .
examples.zh: 许多人认为新的法律力度不够。

examples.en: I’ll tell you all about it when I get back.
examples.zh: 我回来再告诉你这一切。

examples.en: Sheppard was telling the truth .
examples.zh: 谢泼德说的是实话。
